VERIFIED from PostgreSQL (7d window, 197 closed trades):

1) CHOP ENTRY (hard_max_loss) — 62T, 0% WR, -$5.80. Largest loss bucket by far. These entries never reached +0.40% for the trail to arm. Winning side: do not enter, or wait for trend confirmation + trail arm. Every hard_max_loss trade was a coin going nowhere — the money was made by staying out or by entering after the trail confirmed direction.

2) RSI EDGE DECAY on pump-chain+ LONG — verified by meta_rsi bucket: RSI <50: 3T -$0.08; RSI 50-60: 6T 50% WR +$0.64; RSI 61-65: 10T 50% WR +$0.61; RSI 66+: 20T 25% WR -$0.49. The edge lives in the 50-65 band and dies above 65. Today JUP lost twice on pump-chain+ LONG at meta_rsi 66.7 (-$0.08) and 69.4 (-$0.03 re-entry) while BANANA won at 65.2 (+$0.37) and ICP won at 63.2 (+$0.28). Winning side at RSI 66+: skip or wait — the trend is already extended and we are late. Why we keep entering: the signal fires on momentum, but by RSI 66+ the easy move is done.

3) SHORT FADE IN LONG-BIAS MARKET — 7d: 49 SHORTs, 30.6% WR, -$0.62. 24h losers include BTC, IO, MERL, HYPE, IO — every one of these coins is now LONG_BIAS or BTC-above-EMA300. Winning side was LONG in all cases. Why we shorted: signals read local overextension as reversal; the regime said grind-up. Fix already validated: no SHORT while BTC holds EMA300 and 15m is LONG_BIAS.

4) SAME-COIN RE-ENTRY AFTER LOSS — JUP 16199 lost -$0.08 at RSI 66.7, re-entered as 16202 58 minutes later same signal at RSI 69.4, lost again. Winning side: skip the coin for hours after a hard_max_loss. Re-entering a fresh loser at worse conditions compounds the bleed.

5) WORST SIGNAL COMBOS (7d losers): pump-chain+ LONG -$1.73 (21 losers), volume-breakout-long+ LONG -$1.36 (13), pump-chain- SHORT -$1.03 (15), ai-trader+ LONG -$0.53 (8). All share the chop/extended profile above.
